verses.text: Don’t sacrifice an ox or sheep to Yahweh your God if it has a defect or anything wrong with it. Yahweh your God finds that detestable.
Suppose you find a man or woman in one of the towns Yahweh your God gives you who breaks his covenant and does what’s evil in his eyes.
They’ve gone off to serve and bow down to other gods, or to the sun, moon, or any of the stars in the sky, something I never commanded.
When you hear about it, look into it carefully. If you find out for sure that such a detestable thing has happened in Israel,
bring the man or woman who did it out to your town gates and stone that person to death.
A death sentence requires the testimony of two or three witnesses. Nobody may be put to death on the testimony of just one witness.
The witnesses must be the first to act in putting the person to death, and afterward the rest of the people. That’s how you’ll remove the evil from among you.
If a dispute in your town is too hard for you to judge, whether it’s about a death, competing claims, or an injury, get up and go to the place Yahweh your God chooses.
Go to the Levitical priests and the judge serving at the time. Ask them about the case, and they’ll give you the verdict.
Follow the decision they give you from the place Yahweh chooses. Be careful to do everything they teach you.
Follow their instructions on the law and carry out the verdict they give you. Don’t turn away from their ruling to the right or to the left.
Anyone who defiantly refuses to listen to the priest serving there before Yahweh your God, or to the judge, must die. Remove that evil from Israel.
Everyone will hear about it and be afraid to act that defiantly again.
When you enter the land Yahweh your God gives you, settle there, and say, “I want a king over me like all the nations around me,”
make sure you appoint the king Yahweh your God chooses. Choose one of your own people as king. You may not put a foreigner who isn’t one of your own people over you.
The king must not build up a great stock of horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to get more horses. Yahweh told you, “You must never go back that way.”
He must not take many wives for himself, or his heart will turn away. He must not pile up great stores of silver and gold for himself either.
When he takes his seat on the throne, he must write out his own copy of this law in a book, using the copy kept before the Levitical priests.
Keep it with him so he can read it all his life. That way he’ll learn to honor Yahweh his God with reverence and put every word of this law and these rules into practice.
Then he won’t think he’s above his own people or turn away from the command to the right or left. He and his children will reign a long time among the people of Israel.
